Iran Expands Trade Network, Bypassing US Sanctions with China's Help

Iran is expanding its trade network, particularly with China, to circumvent United States sanctions, according to multiple reports. This network involves bartering for billions of dollars worth of Chinese goods. The U.S. Treasury has responded by issuing new sanctions targeting Iranian airlines and their international service providers, aiming to further isolate Tehran from the global economy. These measures also extend to networks aiding Iran's proxies in the Middle East.
